parameters.query: create table if not exists demo_summaries (key text primary key, body jsonb not null, created_at timestamptz not null default now())
select (select json_build_object('runId', id, 'report', report) from demo_runs where status in ('done','partial') order by created_at desc limit 1) as latest

select (select body from demo_summaries where key = $1) as body,
  (select count(*) from demo_summaries where created_at > now() - interval '1 day')::int as today
insert into demo_summaries (key, body) values ($1, $2::jsonb) on conflict (key) do nothing returning key
